title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Windows Desktop Build 298 (Native Google Drive Cloud Sync & Zero-Error Backup)
highlights: Google Drive Cloud Auto-Sync on Windows: Native detection of Google Drive for Desktop with 1-Click activation.
Zero-Error Cloud Backup: Completely removed failing web OAuth dialogs; automatic backups seamlessly sync directly to customer's Google Drive.
Smart Google Drive Guidance: Clean detection card shows real-time Google Drive sync status and download link if not yet installed.
Default Admin Auto-Prefill: Username field is automatically pre-filled with 'admin' so customers never wonder what their username is.
1-Click Continue as Admin: When App Lock is turned OFF in Settings, a single tap on 'Continue as Admin' opens the software without demanding any password.
fixes: Resolved Google OAuth 'Error 400: redirect_uri_mismatch' on Windows desktop by integrating native Google Drive for Desktop auto-sync.
Added 1-click 'Enable Google Drive Cloud Sync' button in Desktop Settings.
Corrected settings save dispatch for instantaneous folder and auto-backup activation.
Pre-filled default admin username on Desktop LoginScreen and added helpful indicator.
Synchronized Windows build metadata to Build 298.
